Azarus: An ancient relic that's used as the core of a gateway. Allowing travel to the past, present or future and travel between worlds, dimensions and or place. The Azarus acts as it's core. The lifeline of the machine.
Spacial Tesseract: An ancient relic that was created and blessed by Palkia's very essence, touching this thing will allow one to travel to other dimensions or parallel world. It also creates distorted echoes upon use. Handle with care.
Time Gear: An ancient relic that was created and blessed by Dialga's very essence, allowing one to pause time in an area. Collecting 3 of these will allow one to travel to the past, present and or future in one go. Handle with care.
Ancient Seal: An ancient relic that appeared to be a fragment of a bigger structure. It looks so foreign and otherworldly that it's easily mistaken for being an alien artifact. There are five of these scattered around the world and when all are collected. They can be taken to where they belonged to bring life to an ancient ruins.
Heirloom Pendant: This heirloom belonged to Nira's family. It was passed down to her after her parents disappeared and she had always been carrying this with her no matter what. It's the only thing left that she has about of her family. What she doesn't know is that this thing is more important than her life. It's a shame that no one told her about the pendant.
Max Elixir: When used, sets HP and MP to 100%
Hourglass of Time: An ancient relic that was forged from time gears while Dialga is present. It's said to have been created while Dialga was passed out after fighting certain pokemon during the Explorers of Sky era... This relic can force the holder to take the first turn no matter how much speed the other opponent has.
Mega Stone: A spherical stone that's made to empower a pokemon further if they're not already overpowered
TheShade: The shade is a relic item that Syllia carries around with her. This item is the shade itself possessing her and forcing her lifeless body to rise back again after fainting mid-combat. Further fuelling her bloodlust for combat and madness. Whenever she comes back mid-fight, she continues off from where she last left off from. There is a way to combat against this but the method is unclear and unknown right now.
Shiny Diamond: When held, turns the pokemon into a shiny. Use /applystone command to permanently embed it to avoid losing the item when fainting.
A&S: A pendant with the shape of a heart. It can be split into two with each one having an engraving. One has a capital A and one has a capital S. They fit perfectly together."
Golden Apple: A majestic, shiny apple. It's pure as gold and somehow it's edible too. Eating it will restore health and MP to max.
